protocol.reference: Frozen v5 candidate, chosen from validation before any v5 public result is used
protocol.reason: The previous synthetic-only MLP showed complementary primary signal but narrowly failed confirmation. Test a distinct original-source pretraining view without source teacher probabilities, and select epochs for the actual fixed final blend rather than standalone NN AUC. Compare one no-pretraining control.
protocol.source: Same public CC0 original129859 rows, all21 exact synthetic train/test overlaps excluded. No direct label overwrite or source rows appended during synthetic fine-tuning.
protocol.features: Existing NeuralFeatures outer-train-only Distance statistics, normal quantiles, imputation and rating/original-category onehots; omit all five original teacher/lookup features. Source data transform with the same outer-train-fitted maps.
protocol.primary_selection: For each of exactly two networks, select epoch by fixed .75v5+.25NN AUC; only highest primary AUC candidate with delta>=.0001 and positive lower conditional bound vs v5 proceeds. Freeze source epochs, fine-tune epochs and weight.
protocol.confirmation: Fixed selected source/fine-tune epochs, positive lower conditional bound vs v5
protocol.final_gate: Fixed five-fold OOF, every fold delta vs v5 positive; pooled delta>=.0002 and conditional lower bound>0. Only then full refit/Library delivery.
protocol.limitation: This remains an sklearn MLP, not RealMLP. Development splits are reused; conditional intervals exclude model-selection uncertainty.

source_audit.target_provenance: Only CC0 original labels. No synthetic labels used to fit teacher or lookup. Exact matches to any synthetic train/test vector excluded.

exact_label_audit.policy: All 21 original rows matching any train/test feature vector remain excluded, regardless of label agreement.
